audit.accountable_evidence_of_who: Accountable evidence of who reached a clinical record, when, and why.
audit.every_read_of_a: Every read of a clinical document is an event. Break-Glass events carry a stated reason and stay flagged for security review.
audit.newest_first_audit_evidence: Newest first. Audit evidence is insert-only and is never edited or removed.
audit.no_clinical_access_has: No clinical access has been recorded yet.
break_glass.break_glass_and_record: Break Glass and record the reason
break_glass.read_only_and_only: Read only, and only this once
break_glass.state_the_emergency_reason: State the emergency reason in the action panel to open this record. Nothing is disclosed until a reason is recorded.
break_glass.this_access_authorizes_no: This access authorizes no draft, no addendum, and no further read. Request an accepted Clinical Handoff for continuing care.
break_glass.this_grants_one_audited: This grants one audited read of signed evidence. It grants no authoring and no ongoing access, and it is flagged for security review.
break_glass.why_ordinary_treating_access: Why ordinary treating access is unavailable right now
break_glass.your_name_your_stated: Your name, your stated reason, and the time of access are recorded against this record and reviewed by the security team.
create.document_authoring_is_tied: Document authoring is tied to the accepted handoff below. The form opens in the action panel so the record context remains visible.
create.no_evidence_has_been: No evidence has been staged yet.
create.only_a_clinician_authoring: Only a clinician authoring this registration can review these items.
create.patient_says_this_is: Patient says this is an external laboratory report...
create.stage_a_patient_provided: Stage a patient-provided file during an active Hospital Registration for a clinician to review during authoring.
create.staging_note: . Staging does not interpret, verify, or incorporate the file.
create.this_handoff_authorizes_you: This handoff authorizes you to create a private draft. It does not grant ongoing access outside this care responsibility.
create.this_stores_custody_facts: This stores custody facts only. A clinician decides what, if anything, belongs in the clinical document.
create.what_the_patient_says: What the patient says this file is
diagnoses.the_assertions_a_new: The assertions a new order may cite. A superseded diagnosis stays readable below but can no longer justify one.
diagnoses.what_this_patient_has: What this patient has been diagnosed with, and when it changed. Signed notes are not included.
diagnosis_lineage.no_diagnosis_has_been: No diagnosis has been asserted for this patient yet.
edit.draft_protection_note: Only you can update this draft. Its recorded encounter time remains :time.
edit.drafts_remain_private_to: Drafts remain private to their author. Signing locks this source document permanently; later clarification is a separate addendum.
edit.evidence_review_recorded_decide: Evidence review recorded. Decide explicitly what, if anything, to incorporate into this draft.
edit.incorporation_decision_recorded_add: Incorporation decision recorded. Add only what you determine belongs in this draft.
edit.review_the_custody_record: Review the custody record and file, then decide whether to incorporate anything into this clinical document. Nothing is added automatically.
edit.signing_locks_this_document: Signing locks this document permanently. Save first: only what is saved is signed.
pages.accepted_handoff_is_required: Accepted handoff is required to create a draft.
pages.accepted_handoffs_will_open: Accepted handoffs will open the appropriate authoring path.
pages.review_your_private_drafts: Review your private drafts and signed clinical evidence. Start a document from an accepted Clinical Handoff in its originating care workflow.
pages.signing_makes_the_source: Signing makes the source record immutable.
record.reconciled_by: Reconciled by :name; original administration stays unchanged.
record.signed_documents_and_source: Signed documents and source-owned administration evidence, in chronological order. Corrections preserve the original evidence.
retention.blocker.continuing_usefulness_: The records are kept for continuing usefulness.
retention.blocker.last_visit_unavailable: The last visit cannot be established: no attendance source is installed.
retention.blocker.legacy_history_unverif: An imported history has no attributable last-visit evidence.
retention.blocker.no_attendance_evidence: No completed attendance is on record, so no last visit is known.
retention.blocker.no_attendance_provider: No attendance provider has vouched for its coverage.
retention.blocker.no_retention_schedule: No retention schedule has been recorded.
retention.blocker.patient_not_found: The patient is not in the registry.
retention.blocker.provider_coverage_behi: Attendance coverage for :detail does not reach far enough.
retention.blocker.provider_coverage_miss: Attendance coverage has never been confirmed for :detail.
retention.blocker.provisional_identity: The identity is not yet confirmed.
retention.blocker.retention_not_expired: The retention period has not ended.
retention.destruction_disabled: Destruction is disabled. This page only reports whether records may be considered.
retention.may_be_reviewed: May be considered for destruction review
retention.schedule_rule: At least :years years from the last visit. A new version may lengthen protection, never shorten it.
retention.title: Clinical record retention
show.access_emergency_use_and: Access, emergency use, and future addenda preserve accountable evidence.
show.addendum_payload_must_be: Addendum payload must be valid JSON.
show.an_addendum_preserves_this: An addendum preserves this signed source and records why new information is needed.
show.signed_evidence_for_this: Signed evidence for this care journey.
show.signed_source_notice: The signed source stays exactly as you signed it. Record what changed as a reasoned addendum instead.
show.use_the_action_panel: Use the action panel to add a reasoned record without changing this document.
show.what_this_signed_document: What this signed document concluded. Each entry is appended; nothing here is ever edited or deleted.
